name: camera-cutoff
description: Adjust Clipping, Ctrl and the mouse wheel over the terrain view (branch feat/camera-cutoff, 2026-11-23, SD, the input of camera-farz-create): a notch of Wheel Down multiplies the view's far clipping by 1.1, Wheel Up divides it, in single precision, kept within 101 and 100000; the near clipping, the distance and the target stay. Read back through Create Camera after each run of notches from the opening view (0, 0 from 3000, far 50000): -1, -1, -3, +5, +1, +3, -60, +120 notches (55000, 60500, 80525.5, 50000, 45454.543, 34150.67, 100000, 101), then two plain notches out (distance 3630, far still 101), one Ctrl notch out (111.100006), then View Selected Camera of the second camera (far 9000, near 50) and two Ctrl notches in (7438.0166, near 50). Studio: the same view, w3.terrain.camera.clipNearer / clipFarther (Ctrl+Wheel Up / Down), Create from view, View. Expected MATCH

steps.eval: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const ed = window.__driveEd; const RAD = Math.PI / 180; const jump = document.querySelector('select[title="Go to a camera"]'); if (!jump) throw new Error('no Cameras tab'); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && jump.options.length < 9; i++) await wait(250); const btn = (sel, t) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].find((b) => b.textContent === t); if (!b) throw new Error('no ' + t + ' button'); return b; }; const create = async () => { btn('.terrain-group-tools button', 'Create from view').click(); await wait(800); }; const clip = async (n) => { for (let i = 0; i < Math.abs(n); i++) await w3.commands.execute(n < 0 ? 'w3.terrain.camera.clipFarther' : 'w3.terrain.camera.clipNearer'); await wait(200); }; const look = async (n) => { const o = [...jump.options].find((o) => o.textContent === '00 we-drive look 0' + n); if (!o) throw new Error('no camera ' + n); jump.value = o.value; jump.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await wait(300); btn('.terrain-region-panel button', 'View').click(); await wait(500); }; ed.lookAt(0, 0); await wait(300); ed.setView({ target: ed.view().target, yaw: 270 * RAD, pitch: 56 * RAD, distance: 3000, fov: 2 * Math.atan(Math.tan(35 * RAD) / ed.aspect()) }); await wait(300); await create(); for (const n of [-1, -1, -3, 5, 1, 3, -60, 120]) { await clip(n); await create(); } ed.setView({ ...ed.view(), distance: 3630 }); await wait(300); await create(); await clip(-1); await create(); await look(2); await clip(2); await create(); await w3.editors.saveAll();
